name: Pi SDR Academy
tagline: Offline lab — five belts from shell to IQ. Fifty challenges.
note: Browse-only on GitHub Pages. Run locally for Start / Check / Submit.

modules_detail.title: Raspberry Pi / Debian Orientation
modules_detail.description: Learn the terminal, filesystem, permissions, processes, and basic system investigation on Debian.

challenges.title: Needle in the Labyrinth
challenges.description: You are already in the challenge folder. The real flag is hidden somewhere under labyrinth/.

challenges.title: The Locked Drawer
challenges.description: You are already in the challenge folder. The flag is in vault/flag.txt, but you cannot read it yet.

challenges.title: Ghost in the Process List
challenges.description: What is this? A "process" is a program that is currently running.

challenges.title: Whispered Variables
challenges.description: You are already in the challenge folder. 1) Open the prepared lab shell: 2) Inside it, list the environment variables: printenv.

challenges.title: The Silent Port
challenges.description: You are already in the challenge folder. A small web service should run only on this computer, but its configuration is broken.

challenges.title: Autopsy of a Pi
challenges.description: You are already in the challenge folder. EchoRelay has more than one problem.

modules_detail.title: Linux Command Line
modules_detail.description: Master pipelines, text extraction, log analysis, and Bash automation.

challenges.title: Pipe Dream
challenges.description: Your task readings.csv has: callsign,region,strength Write the three strongest north callsigns to answer.txt, one per line, strongest first. Try to solve it with grep, sort, head, and cut.

challenges.title: Frequencies in the Fog
challenges.description: Extract all decimal MHz frequencies from bulletin.txt. Create frequencies.txt with one unique number per line in numeric order.

challenges.title: Receiver Log Noir
challenges.description: Count WARN records in receiver.log by component. Write report.txt as component=count, alphabetically by component.

challenges.title: Night Watch Inventory
challenges.description: Complete inventory.sh. Usage: ./inventory.sh DIRECTORY Output: manifest.txt in the current directory Line format: filename,size,sha256 Include only .iq files and sort by filename.

dojos.title: Software Craft
dojos.tagline: Python and C as daily tools.

modules_detail.title: Python
modules_detail.description: Python fundamentals through binary formats, sockets, and automated analysis.

challenges.title: Strength Classifier
challenges.description: Complete classify_signal and summarize in classify.py. Run `python3 classify.py 2 8 19` to try it.

challenges.title: Config Crypt
challenges.description: Complete parse_config in parse_config.py. Rules are documented in its docstring.

challenges.title: Sensor Bones
challenges.description: Complete decode_records in decode.py. Record layout (7 bytes): uint32 little-endian frequency_hz int16 little-endian power_db uint8 status Run `python3 decode.py samples.bin`, then ./check.

challenges.title: Knock on Localhost
challenges.description: Complete request_reading in client.py. Try it with ./run (localhost only).

challenges.title: Noisy Frame Tamer
challenges.description: Complete parse_frames(data) in protocol.py. Frame: AA 55.

challenges.title: The Autopilot Probe
challenges.description: Complete investigate(input_path, output_path). Use only LOCKED rows.

modules_detail.title: C
modules_detail.description: Compile, pointers, memory layout, and debugging C without advanced exploitation.

challenges.title: First Blood Compile
challenges.description: Repair meter.c. Compile with: gcc -Wall -Wextra -Werror -std=c11 meter.c -o meter It must print average=20.0.

challenges.title: Follow the Arrow
challenges.description: Implement swap_ints and sum_array in pointers.c. Do not edit pointers.h.

challenges.title: Bytes Under Glass
challenges.description: Implement decode_header in layout.c. Layout: tag[2], sequence uint16 little-endian, flags byte, length byte.

challenges.title: Length-Prefixed Prey
challenges.description: Implement parse_records in records.c. Record: type byte, length byte, payload bytes.

modules_detail.title: Debugging / GDB
modules_detail.description: Breakpoints, watchpoints, stack frames, sanitizers, and core dumps.

challenges.title: Stop Right There
challenges.description: Run ./run to compile. Use GDB to break at checkpoint and inspect its sample argument.

challenges.title: The Moving Target
challenges.description: Run ./run. Break at inspect_here.

challenges.title: Down the Call Well
challenges.description: Run ./run and use GDB. Break at capture and inspect a backtrace.

challenges.title: Peek Behind the Bytes
challenges.description: Run ./run. In GDB break at inspect_packet.

challenges.title: The Crash Site
challenges.description: Run ./run to see the crash. Use GDB: run, bt, frame 0, info locals.

challenges.title: Wrong Answer, Right Place
challenges.description: Usable means 10 <= sample <= 20. Use GDB to observe the loop, then fix target.c.

modules_detail.title: Linux Systems Programming
modules_detail.description: fork/exec, pipes, signals, threads, sockets, shared memory, and mmap.

challenges.title: Copy Through the FD
challenges.description: A file descriptor is a small integer a process uses to refer to an open file. Complete copy.c using open, read, write, and close rather than stdio copying.

challenges.title: Parent, Child, Pipe
challenges.description: A pipe is a one-way byte stream between processes. Complete pipe_demo.c so a child writes `samples=64` and its parent reads and prints it.

challenges.title: Puppet the Child
challenges.description: fork creates a child, exec replaces its program, and waitpid collects its status. Complete controller.c to run `/bin/echo child_ok` in a child and verify exit status zero.

challenges.title: Local Wire Tap
challenges.description: TCP is a reliable byte stream; connect attaches a socket to an IP address and port. Complete client.py to connect only to the local test server, send PING, and print PONG.

modules_detail.title: DSP Fundamentals
modules_detail.description: Sinusoids, frequency measurement, sampling, aliasing, and a signal analyzer.

challenges.title: Draw the Sine
challenges.description: A sinusoid repeats smoothly; frequency counts cycles per second and amplitude sets height. Complete analyze.py to generate 2048 samples of a 64 Hz, amplitude 0.75 sine at 1024 samples/s.

challenges.title: Count the Cycles
challenges.description: A spectrum estimates how much signal energy lies at each frequency. Use NumPy's real FFT to estimate the strongest frequency in signal.npy.

challenges.title: The Nyquist Line
challenges.description: Sampling converts a continuous-time idea into evenly spaced measurements. Inspect metadata.txt and calculate sample interval, duration, and sample count.

challenges.title: The Impostor Tone
challenges.description: Aliasing makes frequencies above half the sample rate appear at a lower frequency. Measure the apparent frequency of a 900 Hz tone sampled at 1000 samples/s.

challenges.title: Fill the Missing Samples
challenges.description: Interpolation estimates values between known samples. Fill NaNs in sparse.npy with linear interpolation and save reconstructed.npy.

challenges.title: Pocket Spectrum
challenges.description: RMS measures typical signal level while an FFT peak estimates dominant frequency. Analyze signal.npy and write frequency_hz and rms to result.txt.

modules_detail.title: FFT / Frequency Domain
modules_detail.description: FFT bins, spectral leakage, windowing, multi-tone analysis, spectrum analyzer.

challenges.title: One Peak in the Dark
challenges.description: The FFT converts samples over time into complex frequency bins. Find the strongest positive-frequency bin in signal.npy.

challenges.title: Which Bin Holds the Note?
challenges.description: FFT bin spacing is sample_rate / sample_count. Calculate bin spacing and the bin index for the tone in signal.npy.

challenges.title: Energy That Spills
challenges.description: Leakage spreads energy when a captured tone does not complete a whole number of cycles. Compute the peak frequency and fraction of power outside the peak bin.

challenges.title: Close the Curtains
challenges.description: A window tapers capture edges to reduce distant spectral leakage. Compare rectangular and Hann-window power outside five bins around the peak.

modules_detail.title: IQ / SDR Fundamentals
modules_detail.description: Complex baseband, wideband IQ analysis, bandwidth, and unknown captures — software-only.

challenges.title: Name That Capture
challenges.description: Inspect `capture.iq`. Write `complex64` to `answer.txt` after identifying how pairs of float32 values become one complex sample.

challenges.title: I and Q, Face to Face
challenges.description: Compute mean power `mean(abs(x)**2)` and write it to `answer.txt` (tolerance ±0.01). IQ files use little-endian interleaved float32 values: I0,Q0,I1,Q1,...

challenges.title: Blip in the Waterfall
challenges.description: Find the strongest FFT frequency and write it in Hz to `answer.txt` (tolerance ±5 Hz). IQ files use little-endian interleaved float32 values: I0,Q0,I1,Q1,...

challenges.title: How Wide Is the Voice?
challenges.description: Estimate the two-sided occupied bandwidth. Write Hz to `answer.txt`; values from 1000 through 1400 pass.

challenges.title: Bring It Home to DC
challenges.description: Estimate the carrier offset needed to move the signal to baseband. Write the positive offset in Hz to `answer.txt` (±5 Hz).

challenges.title: File With No Name
challenges.description: No sample-rate sidecar is supplied. `receiver_note.txt` gives one timing clue.

modules_detail.title: BPSK
modules_detail.description: Identify and demodulate BPSK through noise, mapping, phase, and frequency offsets.

challenges.title: Two Stars, One Axis
challenges.description: Count the ideal constellation clusters after averaging each 8-sample symbol. Write `two` to `answer.txt`.

challenges.title: Clean BPSK, Clear Text
challenges.description: Decode the 8-samples/symbol capture and write the recovered ASCII flag to `answer.txt`. IQ files use little-endian interleaved float32 values: I0,Q0,I1,Q1,...

challenges.title: BPSK in the Static
challenges.description: Decode the 8-samples/symbol capture and write the recovered ASCII flag to `answer.txt`. IQ files use little-endian interleaved float32 values: I0,Q0,I1,Q1,...

challenges.title: Bits on the Line
challenges.description: Decode the 8-samples/symbol capture and write the recovered ASCII flag to `answer.txt`. `preamble.txt` states the known first bytes so you can resolve the symbol-to-bit mapping.
